Method of Attack: The package was updated with malicious code that monitors the clipboard for Ethereum private keys and exfiltrates them to a remote server.
Attack Vector: Malicious script embedded in package update
Indicators of Compromise: New file called src/index.js in the package
Inclusion of new pre and postinstall hooks in the package.json file
Creation of system.bat and NewFile.ps1 in the user's Startup folder and Programs folder
